component.name: 云听
component.summary: 网易云音乐的非官方 Linux 客户端

description.p: A NetEase Cloud Music client for Linux with a native KDE/Qt interface. It puts your personal recommendations first and supports MPRIS media keys and the system tray.
为 Linux 打造的网易云音乐客户端：原生 KDE/Qt 界面，个人推荐优先， 支持 MPRIS 媒体键与系统托盘。

ul.li: Daily recommendations, personal FM, heart mode and charts
每日推荐、私人漫游、心动模式与排行榜
Line-by-line scrolling lyrics, desktop lyrics and comments
逐行滚动的歌词、桌面歌词与评论区
Listen together with friends, and download songs to play offline
和好友一起听，下载歌曲离线播放
QR code sign-in; likes, playlists and collections stay in sync with your phone
扫码登录，红心、歌单与收藏和手机同步

description.p: Yunting is developed by the community. It is not an official NetEase Cloud Music application and is not affiliated with NetEase.
云听由社区开发，不是网易云音乐的官方应用，与网易公司没有关联。

screenshot.caption: Recommendations: daily picks, heart mode, personal radio and playlists
推荐：每日推荐、心动模式、私人漫游与推荐歌单
A chart with audio quality badges
榜单与音质标记
Dark colors that follow the system
跟随系统的深色配色

description.p: Upload songs to your cloud and import playlists from a song list or other platforms' links. Make your own playlists private and give them up to three tags. Hug and copy comments, and forward events; your own events can change visibility or be deleted. Listen together no longer skips two songs when one change arrives twice.
可以把本机的歌上传到云盘，用歌曲清单或其他平台的链接导入歌单；自己的歌单可设为私密、加最多 3 个标签。评论可以抱一抱、复制，动态可以转发，自己的动态可以改可见范围或删除。一起听不再因为同一次切歌收到两条命令而连跳两首。

Listen together keeps both sides in sync again, invites a friend with one click, shows how often you have listened together and marks songs your friend cannot play. Private messages can be sent, and cards and listen-together invites in them can be opened. Chinese and Japanese use one font, also in the Flatpak, and multi-line Chinese text gets more line spacing.
一起听双方重新保持同步，点好友即可邀请，显示你们一起听过多少，并标出对方放不了的歌。私信可以发送，里面的卡片和一起听邀请可以点开。中日文使用同一款字体（Flatpak 版也一样），中文多行正文的行距加大。

After switching songs, changing audio quality or seeking, the progress bar and lyrics no longer jump back for a moment. The Flatpak uses system portals to keep the computer awake and to store your login; if you signed in to an earlier Flatpak build, sign in once more.
切歌、换音质或拖动进度后，进度条和歌词不再短暂跳回。Flatpak 版改用系统门户来防止睡眠和保存登录信息；以前用 Flatpak 版登录过的，需要重新登录一次。

The listen-together button on the player bar now opens a panel that lists your mutual follows: friends who are listening together or online come first, the rest show when you last listened together. The app icon follows the colour scheme, so it is light on a dark theme. Rows in the Similar pane are spaced like every other list.
点播放条上的「一起听」，弹出的面板会列出互相关注的好友：正在一起听的、在线的排在前面，其余显示上次和你一起听的时间。应用图标随配色变化，暗色主题下是浅色图标。「相似」栏的歌曲行间距与其他列表一致。

The "Last month" listening-rank tab no longer stays on "Loading...". Switching tabs now requests the selected range, and a late response for the previous tab cannot overwrite it. Tile titles containing a line break stay on one line.
「最近一月」听歌排行不再一直显示「正在取回」；切换周/月会请求当前选择，旧标签页的迟到回包不会覆盖新数据。标题里带换行的磁贴标题保持单行。
Avatar pendants that fail to load are retried with a fresh cache-busting URL, so a transient image failure no longer hides the pendant until the app restarts.
头像挂件加载失败时会用新的缓存破坏地址重试，不再因为一次临时失败就藏到重启应用为止。

Your own avatar pendant in the header and on user pages; user pages show anyone's worn pendant without waiting for it. The SVIP badge is a quiet tint of the accent colour, and comments, wiki and similar run down to the progress line.
页头和用户主页显示自己的头像挂件，别人主页戴着的挂件也显示，且不再拖慢主页；SVIP 标改为主题色的淡渐变；评论、百科、相似一直铺到进度线。

A "Similar" pane on the now-playing page; avatar pendants and distinct VIP / SVIP badges; the suggested search keyword. "Open in client" from the browser works even when the desktop portal has no display, and launching again returns to the open window at once.
正在播放页多了「相似」一栏；显示头像挂件，VIP 与 SVIP 分得出；搜索框显示推荐词。浏览器里的「在客户端打开」在门户没有图形环境时也能打开，再次启动立刻回到已开的窗口。

NetEase links open in the app: "open in client" on the web, links passed on the command line, and links copied in other apps (including phone short links), after asking. Albums and logged-out playlists can be shared, long descriptions open in full, and launching again returns to the open window.
网易云的链接在云听里打开：网页上的「在客户端打开」、命令行里的链接、在别的程序里复制的链接（含手机分享的短链，先问一句）。专辑与未登录时的歌单可以分享，长简介可以展开，再次启动回到已经打开的窗口。
The now-playing cover sits on the page with a thin contact shadow instead of floating above it.
正在播放页的封面改为贴着页面的薄阴影，像放在桌上，不再浮起来。
Comments on playlists can be liked; the now-playing cover gets a soft shadow and rounded corners; downloads keep the song's duration and a second click no longer downloads a song twice.
歌单评论也能点赞；正在播放页的封面有了柔和的投影和圆角；下载的歌记下时长，取地址时再点一次不会重复下载。
